classes.note: a rank-1 block reads identically in any click basis, so it anchors the scale and tests no sign

definitions.a: clicks in the success modes over clicks in the success and failure modes, per iteration or pooled
definitions.a_anchor: mean of the returned anchor T iteration readings
definitions.a_dark: mean of the pooled dark readings of every segment
definitions.odds_corrected: a_prime with its odds divided by r; r is the odds of the normalized pooled null level over the odds of the null ideal
definitions.pooling: the two iterations of one arm in one segment add their clicks
definitions.raw_tests: dark spread, anchor drift, repeated pairs and null levels use raw a
definitions.sentinel_share: clicks in the sentinel modes over the iteration's returned events (samples)

interpretation: Conformance of programmed operator blocks to their interference law on one 12-mode mesh; the client computes every cd_core sign, so the chip does not compute the algebra.
